purpose: Research on kidney function in chronic kidney disease to improve referral guidelines for nephrology care.
question: Among patients with chronic kidney disease, what share has a latest eGFR below 45, by sex and age band?
definitions: Chronic kidney disease = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with N18.
Use the latest eGFR (LOINC 62238-1) per patient; patients without an eGFR are left out.
Reduced kidney function = latest eGFR below 45.
Report per sex and age band: patients with chronic kidney disease, how many of them have reduced kidney function and that share in %, one decimal.
